player_knew.notes: before: corllt_12691, corsolar_20037, corsolar_22545, cornanotc_20410, corhllt_10583, cornanotc_22093, corvp_1291, corsolar_31698. after (the 'lost X to Y' or 'abandoned' line only): cormex_1850, cormex_21827, cornanotc_3536. dropped_itself: corsolar_22545 and cornanotc_22093 (U3), and corvp_1291, whose primary cause is U9 and which the player dropped on seeing it was a duplicate.

mechanisms: The same-tick id race: constructor_16990 and constructor_24695 played 'corvp spot_17 #vp2' in one second, each saw the id free, and both started a plant on an income of 7-11, so corvp_1291 was a second plant (285 metal, cut to about 70 had the 12:55 stop landed at once). Fixed 2026-10-12 (lists::nearest_first, same_tick_help) and unmeasured since. The id's claim still sent constructor_16990 to repair the dropped frame at 13:36.

The energy stall of 11:04-12:00: the energy store was at 0 on +130-270 a second while three Twin Guards, a nano, a refused HLT and the plant drew from the 10:04-10:40 lists. cornanotc_20410 was at 64% after 71 s; at the full rate (56 s) it would have stood by about 11:44, before the Stouts hit its builder at 11:54. cornanotc_22093 was dropped at 23% for solars because of the same stall. That is 200 metal, plus corhllt_10583 (168) marginally, about 5 s slower in its first 27 s.

Frames started into a known enemy's path with no army to cover them. The Blitz raids took cormex_1850, corllt_12691, corsolar_20037 and cormex_21827 (63 metal); two of these were list steps queued earlier that walked their builder onto a standing Blitz or were promoted while the builder was hit. party_27's Stouts at home took corhllt_10583, killed at 86% with its builder on it (168), and cornanotc_3536 (34), which a stale list step had re-sited at home instead of resuming the standing nano. That is 265 metal in all; only the 8 metal of the two queued-step frames is a hands-rule fix, and the rest needs army cover.
findings: The report's 'abandoned an unfinished X (N% built)' line gives the share left at destruction, not the share reached: the corsolar left at 31% read '1% built' and the nano left at 15% read '0% built'. It also called the Twin Guard killed by Stout fire at 86% 'abandoned (14% built)'.
The realtime landing delay raised the loss on both of the player's drop orders: the 9:22 stop landed at 9:33 (the frame went from 1% to 31%), and the 12:55 stop landed at 13:08 (12% to about 43%).

A diverted list step with no place was re-sited near the builder rather than resuming the frame it had left: constructor_26263's one 'cornanotc' step made three frames (20410 at G2, 3536 at G1, 22093 at H2) and none finished.
unread: Nothing torn and no tool crashed. This record (2026-10-07) predates the placed-site event (6ea433b), so the engine's chosen site is not recorded: for the commander's 2:08 solar (left at U6 with low confidence) and for the two #vp2 frames, which went up about 400 from the ordered point. Single seat; no symlink directory was needed.
